# one JSON line: find the rome sbatch template under $WORK
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function run_out(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd), stdout = out, stderr = err))
    catch e
        return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
    return String(take!(out)) * (position(err) > 0 ? "\n[stderr]\n" * String(take!(err)) : "")
end
work = get(ENV, "WORK", "")
parts = Pair{String,String}[]
push!(parts, "ls_work" => run_out(`ls -la $work`))
push!(parts, "find" => run_out(`find $work -maxdepth 4 -name "run_job_cpu_parallel_rome*"`))
push!(parts, "find_poller" => run_out(`find $work -maxdepth 3 -name "poller.sh"`))
push!(parts, "scontrol_cmd" => run_out(`scontrol show job 2098965`))
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
